description: Create a new assignment group (a gradebook category such as Homework or Exams) in a course and return the created Canvas assignment group object, including its `id`, `name`, `position` and `group_weight`. Not idempotent: each call makes another group even when the name matches an existing one, so read `list_assignment_groups` first and use `update_assignment_group` to change a group that already exists; the new group starts empty, and assignments move into it through `create_assignment` or `update_assignment`'s assignment_group_id. `group_weight` is the group's percent of the final grade, and it changes nothing unless the course is set to weight its final grade by assignment group — a course setting `update_course` can turn on. Canvas coerces a missing or non-numeric `group_weight` to 0. Drop rules are deliberately not accepted here: Canvas validates them against the number of active assignments in the group, which is 0 for a group that does not exist yet, so set them with `update_assignment_group` once the group has assignments. Requires permission to manage assignments in the course.

group_weight.description: The group's percent of the total grade (e.g. 40 for 40%)

position.description: 1-based position of this group relative to the other assignment groups

sis_source_id.description: The SIS source ID for the group

name: create_assignment_group
title: Create Assignment Group
